description: This file contains a Redux reducer managing the dashboard state in a Superset frontend application. It handles actions related to dashboard slices, tabs, filters, chart states, and various UI flags.

classes.name: ChartStateEntry
classes.description: Represents the state of an individual chart within the dashboard, including its ID, visualization type, state object, and last modification timestamp.

classes.name: DashboardStateShape
classes.description: Defines the shape of the dashboard's Redux state, including slices, tabs, filters, chart states, and various UI flags.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents a dashboard slice with its ID and additional properties.

classes.name: DashboardStateAction
classes.description: Defines the structure of actions dispatched to modify the dashboard state.

methods.name: dashboardStateReducer
methods.description: Main reducer function that updates the dashboard state based on dispatched actions.
